description: TY2027 SALT for married filing separately: § 164(b)(7) makes the 2027 amount 101% of 2026 — $40,804 — and the threshold $510,050 (half, $255,025, for MFS). MFS, AGI $300,000, SALT paid $30,000: $40,804 − 30% × ($300,000 − $255,025) = $27,311.50, above the $10,000 floor; half for MFS (§ 164(b)(6)(B)) = $13,655.75.
